build_student_whisper_model: build a student Whisper model from a pre-trained teacher model for teacher-student distillation
create_distilled_decoder: create a distilled Whisper decoder with a specified number of layers from a teacher checkpoint
run_model_conversion: run teacher-to-student model conversion with custom encoder and decoder layer counts
test_forward_pass: test the converted student model with a forward pass to verify it loads and runs correctly
push_student_to_hub: push the distilled student model weights and processor to the Hugging Face Hub
